_comment: Hand corrections for the macro page. Applied last, so they always win. Everything here is optional — an empty file is the normal state.
_fomc: The Fed publishes meeting dates only as a web page, with no feed. build-macro.js parses that page and refuses to publish a parse it cannot validate, so if the layout changes you get a warning and no FOMC events rather than wrong dates on a calendar people plan around. If that happens, paste the dates here and they are used instead. `date` is the FINAL day of the meeting, which is when the decision and press conference land. `sep` marks the meetings that carry the Summary of Economic Projections and dot plot.
_hide: Indicator ids from scripts/macro-spec.js to leave off the page entirely. Their series are not even fetched.
